info.title: Sockseek daemon API
info.description: HTTP API for the Sockseek daemon.

get.summary: Gets a composite remote Soulseek user profile.
Observes a peer's presence without fetching profile details.
Gets a validated remote Soulseek user profile picture.
Gets independent upload-access and private-message restrictions for one exact username.

put.summary: Sets or removes one durable exact-username restriction override.
put.description: Upload-access blocking denies future search, browse, directory, and upload admissions from the peer. Private-message blocking discards future incoming DMs only. Allowed supersedes that kind's configured username block. Null removes only that override. Configured upload IP denial remains independent.

post.summary: Starts, joins, or reuses a remote user's share browse.

get.summary: Lists recent remote-user browse resources.
Gets one remote-user browse resource.
Gets one user-browse replication snapshot and stream position.

post.summary: Globally cancels a shared browse acquisition.

get.summary: Gets a stable page of share directories.
Gets one share directory.
Gets a stable page of files in one share directory.
Searches one immutable share artifact as flat directory/file rows.

post.summary: Starts ordinary remote downloads from a browse selection.
Streams an immutable browser input into daemon-owned expiring storage.
post.description: The browser filename is retained only as safe presentation metadata and is never used as a daemon path. No internal file-size cap is imposed.

get.summary: Gets immutable artifact metadata.

post.summary: Creates an asynchronous preview from the shared Core planner.
post.description: Returns the Planning resource immediately. Wait for completion through its summary, then page the reviewed nodes.

get.summary: Gets the fixed-size preview summary and current revision.
get.description: With waitForCompletion=true, waits up to 30 seconds while Planning. Returns immediately on completion; request cancellation stops waiting without cancelling planning.

get.summary: Pages preview roots or the direct children of one stable planner ref.

post.summary: Commits a client-owned revision-bound selection without replanning or rereading its source.
Creates a revisioned projection over a live or retained search.
post.description: Returns revision zero immediately. Poll the latest summary revision while the search is running, then page its typed collections from one immutable revision.

get.summary: Gets fixed-size counters and the latest immutable revision.
Gets the exact projection and effective search settings retained for this view.
Pages file rows from one immutable search-view revision.
get.description: sortOrder reorders the existing projected rows; omitting it uses the view default. Keep the same sortOrder value (or omission) when continuing a cursor. Cursors bind the view, revision and requested order; counters describe the same revision as the rows.

get.summary: Pages exact peer-directory summaries from one immutable revision.
get.description: sortOrder reorders existing directory summaries; omitting it uses the view default. Keep the same sortOrder value (or omission) when continuing a cursor. Membership, counters and child-file ordering retain their revision semantics.

get.summary: Pages exact relative child paths under a directory in one immutable revision.

post.summary: Retrieves an exact peer directory issued by a Search View revision.
post.description: Runs the generic folder-retrieval job. Completion publishes retrieved totals and child refs as a new immutable Search View revision; the issuing revision remains unchanged.

get.summary: Pages track group summaries from one immutable revision.
Pages one track group's ordered alternatives.
Pages album group summaries from one immutable revision.
Pages one album group's directory alternatives.

post.summary: Reads exact browser-held group choices in one Search View revision.
post.description: Returns a current option DTO or an explicit miss for each requested group. Choices remain client-owned and are never saved by this read.

get.summary: Gets the latest fixed-size summary for inexpensive live refresh.
get.description: When HasNewRevision is true, refetch only visible pages and expanded groups at Summary.Revision. Optional waitForChange waits up to one second for a new revision; completed Views return immediately.

post.summary: Commits a client-owned revision-bound selection as one submission.
post.description: The fixed-size receipt reports independent resolution outcomes; runtime jobs are traversed through the jobs API.

post.summary: Resolves the effective download defaults for a client-owned selection.
Counts observed public and locked files in a client-owned selection.

get.summary: Gets server identity and protocol information.
Gets current daemon and Soulseek client status.
Gets the bounded daemon replication snapshot and stream position.
get.description: Contains active workflows and the jobs, searches, and transfers needed to render them. Retained terminal history remains paginated.

post.summary: Runs SQLite integrity_check against the live database.
Creates and independently verifies a WAL-safe online backup.
Requests a bounded passive WAL checkpoint.
Runs one bounded retention batch.

get.summary: Gets a bounded recoverable conversation snapshot.
Gets a bounded recoverable room snapshot.
Gets compact chat runtime status.
Pages private-message conversations.

post.summary: Sends an idempotent private message.

get.summary: Gets an existing conversation by exact peer username without creating one.
Gets a private-message conversation.
Pages messages in a private conversation.

post.summary: Sends an idempotent message to a conversation.
Advances a conversation's local read watermark.
Archives or reactivates a conversation.

get.summary: Pages rooms visible to the current Soulseek account.
Pages known room subscriptions and runtime state.

post.summary: Joins a room and optionally remembers it across restarts.

get.summary: Gets room subscription, join, and private-room metadata.

delete.summary: Leaves a room and removes its runtime subscription.

get.summary: Pages messages in a joined or retained room.

post.summary: Sends an idempotent room message.
Advances a room's local read watermark.

get.summary: Pages the current ephemeral room roster.

post.summary: Adds a member to a joined private room.

get.summary: Pages durable chat notifications.
Gets a durable chat notification.

post.summary: Marks one notification read.
Marks a bounded notification set or sequence range read.

get.summary: Gets one complete workflow replication snapshot and its workflow-local stream position.
Lists configured download profiles.
Lists durable accepted submissions newest first.
get.description: Traverse runtime jobs with /api/jobs?submissionId= rather than embedding them here.

get.summary: Gets safe durable submission metadata.

delete.summary: Permanently deletes one terminal submission and its jobs.
delete.description: Downloaded files, transfers and their statistics are preserved. Nonterminal submissions are rejected.

post.summary: Permanently deletes completed submissions and results, preserving transfers and downloaded files.
Reruns a submission from its retained normalized command and effective settings.
post.description: Current credentials are rebound only for retained credential slots. Current defaults and profiles do not replace the retained root settings.

post.summary: Replays only one planned search job from its retained execution settings.
post.description: Sibling jobs are not restarted. Older submissions without retained child identities cannot be replayed through this operation.

get.summary: Lists known jobs.
get.description: Default results contain execution roots in ascending display order. Set newestFirst=true for newest-first moving-keyset pages; cursors are bound to that direction. Set parentJobId for direct children, submissionId or role for submission semantics, or includeAll=true for a flat workflow list. Set excludeExtractResults=true to page extraction sources without also counting their generated results.

X-Sockseek-Read-Epoch.description: Daemon epoch captured before reading live and retained jobs.

X-Sockseek-Read-Sequence.description: Daemon sequence at that read position, encoded as a decimal Int64 string.

post.summary: Gets the same displayed job-list snapshot used by live observations.
Reads current live or retained job summaries by ID.
post.description: Returns found IDs once in request order; missing IDs are omitted. Does not hydrate job details or count children.

get.summary: Gets a job snapshot by id.
Pages exact files in the accepted attempt of an album or remote-directory job.
Gets a job snapshot by workflow and display id.
Gets raw search responses for a search job.
get.description: Use afterSequence to incrementally fetch raw responses after the last seen sequence.

post.summary: Starts a folder retrieval job for a selected album result folder.
post.description: Retrieves the full remote folder contents for a selected folder result. Search responses can omit child items that did not match the original query.

post.summary: Starts one or more file download jobs from selected search result files.
post.description: The source search job identifies where the candidate refs came from. Per-download settings belong in the request options, not in the original search job.

post.summary: Starts an album/folder download job from a selected folder result.
post.description: The source search job identifies where the folder ref came from. Per-download settings belong in the request options, not in the original search job.

post.summary: Completes a manual-selection job without starting additional downloads.
post.description: Use this when a DownloadBehavior.Manual job reached AwaitingSelection and the caller wants to close the manual step without resuming the job.

post.summary: Skips a manual-selection job without starting additional downloads.
post.description: Use this when a DownloadBehavior.Manual job reached AwaitingSelection and the caller wants to record an explicit user skip.

post.summary: Cancels a job when cancellation is available.
Cancels all currently cancellable daemon jobs.
post.description: The daemon remains running and can accept later submissions.

post.summary: Cancels a workflow job by display id.
post.description: Convenience endpoint for CLI-style cancellation prompts. Normal GUI clients should prefer AvailableActions on known job ids.

post.summary: Tries the next candidate for an active job download.
Tries the next candidate for an active job download by display id.
Submits an input extraction job.
Resolves the effective settings for a job draft without submitting it.
post.description: Uses the same typed settings composer as direct Start. An extract or generic-search draft may omit its not-yet-entered input for provisional settings; actual submission still validates it. Secret and command values are redacted; matched profiles and safe per-field provenance are returned for Review and diagnostics.

post.summary: Submits a generic Soulseek search job.
post.description: Search jobs are discovery-oriented. They store raw Soulseek results; use projection endpoints to view those results as files, album folders, or group candidates, then use follow-up download endpoints for selected refs.

post.summary: Submits a track search job.
post.description: Track search jobs are suitable for exploratory pick-then-download UIs: inspect projected file candidates from the result endpoints, then start follow-up downloads from selected refs.

post.summary: Submits an album search job.
post.description: Album search jobs are suitable for exploratory pick-then-download clients: create an immutable Search View, page its directory projection, then commit revision-bound refs.

post.summary: Submits a single-file download job.
post.description: Use DownloadBehavior.Automatic for normal transfer jobs. Use DownloadBehavior.Manual when the job should pause at AwaitingSelection for caller approval/selection before resuming the same job.

post.summary: Submits an album/folder download job.
post.description: Use DownloadBehavior.Automatic for normal transfer jobs. Use DownloadBehavior.Manual when the job should pause at AwaitingSelection for caller approval/selection before resuming the same job.

post.summary: Submits a grouped track search job.
post.description: Grouped-song jobs can download automatically or, with DownloadBehavior.Manual, pause after candidate grouping so the caller can choose which child downloads to resume.

post.summary: Submits a grouped album search job.
post.description: Grouped album jobs can download automatically or, with DownloadBehavior.Manual, pause after bucket projection so the caller can choose which child downloads to resume.

post.summary: Submits a job list from draft child jobs.
post.description: Job drafts are submission payloads only. Submitted children appear as normal runtime jobs in subsequent job/workflow snapshots.

get.summary: Lists known workflows.
Gets a workflow snapshot by id.
get.description: Use the cursor-paged jobs collection to list workflow roots or descendants.

post.summary: Cancels cancellable jobs in a workflow.

get.summary: Pages the combined newest-first live and retained transfer timeline.
get.description: The cursor is a moving keyset over stable creation time and transfer ID. New transfers may appear above an existing traversal; status changes do not reorder rows.

get.summary: Gets bounded transfer analytics for a dashboard range.
get.description: Ranges are 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, 1y, or all. Coverage explicitly reports retention and persistence degradation; byte activity is cumulative-attempt accounting, not transfer creation size.

get.summary: Pages the bounded live transfer queue.

post.summary: Looks up current visible transfer timeline rows by ID.
post.description: Uses the same live, queued and retained projection as the timeline. Returns all found IDs in newest-first order without a continuation. Missing IDs are omitted; retained availability is explicit.

post.summary: Snapshots a timeline extent, expanded files and requested folder totals.
post.description: Uses the same scoped read as ObserveTransferTimeline. Window membership and boundary describe the moving prefix independently of explicitly requested additional files.

post.summary: Gets moving whole-group totals for the requested transfer groups.
post.description: Uses the retained transfer ledger with a live overlay; group refs are opaque, and an unavailable retained resource does not yield authoritative totals.

get.summary: Gets one transfer with its latest attempt and optional queue estimate.

delete.description: Removal hides a terminal transfer from ordinary listings while preserving history and statistics. Nonterminal transfers are rejected.

post.summary: Cancels a queued or active download or upload transfer.
Cancels a snapshot of transfers by direction, queue state, and optional exact peer/group.
post.description: Targets are resolved once, then cancelled independently. Races and per-transfer failures are reported in a fixed-size receipt.

post.summary: Removes terminal transfers from listings, optionally scoped to an exact peer/group.
post.description: Preserves retained history and statistics, excludes active transfers, and returns bounded outcome counts.

get.summary: Lists current and retained attempts for one transfer.
Gets bounded sharing and catalog status.

post.summary: Starts a share scan or returns the currently active scan.

get.summary: Gets an active or recently completed share scan.

post.summary: Cancels an active share scan.

post.description: First GET /api/auth/session for the antiforgery cookie and token; send that token in X-CSRF-Token. After login, GET the session again to refresh the token.

ApiKey.description: A named operator API key. Explicit invalid keys never fall back to cookies.
ApiKey.name: X-API-Key

Browser.description: WebUI session; mutations additionally require X-CSRF-Token from /api/auth/session.
Browser.name: sockseek-session
